notes: Themed negative searches and the watchdog/NGO sweep returned nothing in-window (all hits were evergreen or pre-window, e.g. HRW Riyadh Comedy Festival piece dated 2025-09-23, exactly one year outside window). The General/Macro Press outlet sweep DID surface in-window (2026-09-23) stories naming Saudi Arabia in a geopolitical/security context amid an active Houthi/Iran escalation, so the adversarial-framing check was applicable and was run: AFP (via The Manila Times) 'Riyadh attacks key port city - Houthis' foregrounds Saudi as attacker (Houthi claim) alongside the humanitarian toll, and Al Jazeera (Qatari state-funded) framed UK refuelling support through a Western-complicity lens. Both were verified in-window via WebFetch and are carried as the two Negative Articles items. Amwaj.media's 23 Sep hedging analysis was reviewed and folded into the Risks synthesis rather than run as a separate item.
